name: Liudon
summary: Liudon's personal blog, a Hugo site whose source is public in Liudon/liudon.github.io (no licence file). It stays at Level 2 because its posts load Google's AdSense script from pagead2.googlesyndication.com as they open, and one embeds a Bilibili player. The home page loads only the site's own files.
